answer: An appeal-bonded jury court makes a challenged identity pay its defense against bulk fakes. It does not harbor unverified identities: each newcomer posts 80 credits, challengeable with a matching 80. Seven rotating jurors check evidence under a ferrous stamp. A hollow identity with no work history loses its bond, half burned, half to the challenger. Jurors stake 20 each, lost on overturned appeal, so the k-th fake needs its own bond plus a fresh jury, defeating the jury bribery ring; 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits, linear with no bulk discount, an honest agent posts once.
